correctness.rationale: Reconstructed RESULT.md lines 19–54. Multiplication and addition are monotone for the natural order; s≼s² makes every positive power nondecreasing, and the evaluation of θ on A is Σ_a w_a^|A|, so adding elements cannot decrease it. For any candidate prenex existential NNF sentence, separate its expansion on J_t into old assignments and assignments that use b. At t=1 all factors are 0 or 1. The old sum equals 1, and the new total is 1, so unit nonabsorption and zero-sum-freeness force every extra monomial to have a zero factor. No zero factor changes at t=u≠0, so extra assignments still contribute zero; equality with θ would force u²=u. The argument requires no absence of zero divisors, and works for arbitrary existential tuple length, including no quantifiers. The saturation map from ℕ preserves both operations (including multiplication by zero). The natural order is the ordinary order and u=2 distinguishes the powers at M≥3; at M=1,2 multiplication is idempotent, so θ collapses to ∃x R(x). Both sentences are zero on the empty domain if allowed. VERIFICATION.md and checker.py were inspected, not executed. The proof, not bounded checks over example interpretations, addresses every existential formula.
